seo.metaDescription: Hurt in a Moorpark car accident? Get connected free to an independent attorney. No fee unless you recover. Serving Ventura County.

hero.subtitle: If a crash on Los Angeles Avenue, Tierra Rejada Road, or SR-118 left you hurt, LawProactive can connect you with an independent Moorpark-area attorney at no cost to you.

about.title: Moorpark Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Moorpark's roads carry a mix of local traffic and commuters cutting through on SR-118, and the corridors that see the most collisions — Los Angeles Avenue, Tierra Rejada Road, and the Ronald Reagan Freeway — are also where many injury crashes happen, often clustering on Wednesday afternoons when traffic builds. In the most recent full year on record, Moorpark saw 96 injury collisions and 129 people hurt. Behind those numbers are real people dealing with medical bills, missed work, and insurance adjusters who call before the dust has settled. LawProactive doesn't practice law or promise results — we simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney in the Ventura County area who can look at what happened and explain your options. Every case is different, and timing matters, especially when evidence like skid marks, dashcam footage, or witness memories can fade fast.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a lawsuit, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity — like a public road agency — is involved. An attorney can help figure out which deadline applies to your situation before it passes.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cost You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces what you can recover. Insurers know this and often push blame onto injured drivers early, which is why a recorded statement without guidance can work against you.

items.title: No Cap, No Upfront Cost
items.desc: California doesn't cap non-economic damages like pain and suffering, so an accurate accounting of your losses matters. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover something.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps calling — should I give them a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use those statements to shift blame or minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: My crash happened on Tierra Rejada Road near a city intersection — does that change my deadline?
items.answer: It might. If a government entity, like the City of Moorpark or Caltrans, is potentially responsible for a road hazard, claims against public entities can require notice in as little as six months rather than the usual two-year window. An attorney can help sort out who's involved and what deadline applies.

items.question: What does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney, and attorneys in our network typically work on contingency — meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward after speaking with them.
